description:
Create a booking system in the 'demodb' database using OrientDB Sequences and Graph connections.

1. Create two ORDERED sequences:
   - 'booking_seq' starting at 1000, increment 1
   - 'invoice_seq' starting at 5000, increment 1

2. Create a vertex class 'Bookings' (extends V) with properties:
   - BookingRef (INTEGER)
   - InvoiceNum (INTEGER)
   - CheckIn (DATE)
   - CheckOut (DATE)
   - Status (STRING)
   - TotalPrice (DOUBLE)

3. Create edge classes 'HasBooking' and 'BookedAt' (both extend E).

4. Insert 5 bookings using the sequences for IDs:
   - John Smith (john.smith@example.com) at 'Hotel Artemide': 2025-06-15 to 2025-06-20, Confirmed, 1250.00
   - Maria Garcia (maria.garcia@example.com) at 'Hotel Adlon Kempinski': 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-05, Confirmed, 1800.00
   - David Jones (david.jones@example.com) at 'The Savoy': 2025-07-10 to 2025-07-14, Pending, 2200.00
   - Sophie Martin (sophie.martin@example.com) at 'Hotel de Crillon': 2025-08-01 to 2025-08-07, Confirmed, 3500.00
   - Luca Rossi (luca.rossi@example.com) at 'The Plaza Hotel': 2025-09-15 to 2025-09-18, Cancelled, 1650.00

5. Create edges:
   - 'HasBooking' from Profile to Booking
   - 'BookedAt' from Booking to Hotel

6. Export the list of bookings (BookingRef, InvoiceNum, CheckIn, CheckOut, Status, TotalPrice) ordered by BookingRef to '~/bookings_report.json'.
